newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers gain $1, healthy buying resumes.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers gain $1, healthy buying resumes.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers gained by $1 a tonne and finally saw a return to healthy volumes, while the Mediterranean was steady to soft, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted in the range $90/91 fob although some suppliers were prepared to offer as low as $89 in early trading.
The strength came partly with an improvement in the bunker market and partly from the slight, but not desperate, shortage of product in the ARA region.
Total ARA volume surpassed 20,000 tonnes by most estimates. Some put the figure as high as 30,000 tonnes.
"It's reasonable, and we needed that after the dull week we've had," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices also rose by $1 a tonne in thin trading.
Mediterranean bunkers were steady to slightly firmer. Piraeus quotes were steady, but were seen possibly weakening as the week's supply problems came to an end.
